official_category_name: Colleges of Agriculture and Related Disciplines
title: Nigeria Colleges of Agriculture
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for current Nigerian Colleges of Agriculture and Related Disciplines in the NBTE 25th Edition 2025 directory.
methodology: SoftData reconciled the complete 32-entry NBTE Colleges of Agriculture and Related Disciplines section before generating the dataset. Names and locations were normalized to current canonical forms and mapped to ng-states. The source-marked Zuru conversion was excluded; no university, polytechnic, monotechnic, health, nursing, technical-college, IEI, VEI, research-only or closed institution was imported.
source_hierarchy: Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security

sources.title: 25th Edition 2025 Directory of Accredited Programmes
sources.purpose: Primary roster boundary for Colleges of Agriculture and Related Disciplines.
categories_included: Colleges of Agriculture and Related Disciplines
missing_or_incomplete_fields: state_id is not a source field
some source names use source abbreviations or punctuation variants
the source marks College of Agriculture, Zuru as converted to a university

sources.title: Approved Institutions
sources.purpose: Confirm the NBTE category separation from polytechnics, monotechnics, colleges and IEIs.

inclusion_boundary: Only entries in the NBTE Colleges of Agriculture and Related Disciplines category that remain current regulated college identities.
exclusion_rules: research institutes without a separately approved college
transitions_and_former_names: Former names, conversions and category transitions are recorded in the reconciliation manifest. College of Agriculture, Zuru is excluded because the source marks it converted to a university.
update_frequency: Review on each new NBTE directory or material regulatory roster update.
known_limitations: The NBTE source is not active-only and does not normalize state_id.
Institution approval, ownership and naming can change between directory editions.
No specialisation field is exposed in the public contract; source category is preserved in metadata.
rights: SoftData compilation, schema and metadata are CC BY 4.0. NBTE source publications retain their own rights. This pass adds only the static dataset foundation; websites, logos and API routes are deferred.
